description:
Make Session itself the production implementation of OctoPi.Coder.Extension.Host. No separate Host GenServer — Session handles Host messages directly via handle_cast/handle_call. Set ctx.host = session_pid in every Context.new site.

This closes the runtime gap that opi-fin.6 left open: the Host behaviour was defined and extensions were migrated to call Host.send_message(ctx.host, ...), but ctx.host was nil at runtime so every such call silently failed (caught by safe_call's rescue).

## Deliverable

For every callback declared in OctoPi.Coder.Extension.Host (apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/extension/host.ex), Session has the corresponding handle_cast (for fire-and-forget) or handle_call (for getters) clause. Runner sets ctx.host to the session_pid it was given at start_link.

## Steps

STEP 1 — Audit every @callback in apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/extension/host.ex. List: send_message, send_user_message, append_entry, set_model, set_thinking_level, compact, set_active_tools, set_session_name, set_label, register_tool, abort, exec, get_model, get_thinking_level, get_system_prompt, get_active_tools, get_all_tools, get_session_name, get_commands, get_context_usage.

STEP 2 — In Session, add handle_cast clauses for casts (send_message, send_user_message, register_tool, abort, etc.) and handle_call clauses for getters (get_model, get_all_tools, etc.). Most map to existing Session API (Session.prompt, Session.add_tool); wire them up.

STEP 3 — Update Runner's ctx construction so ctx.host is set to state.session_pid.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Every @callback in host.ex has a matching handle_cast or handle_call in apps/octo_pi_agent/lib/octo_pi/agent/session.ex (verify by counting callbacks vs handlers)
- [ ] Test: extension with on_event/3 that calls Host.send_message(ctx.host, "hi") → Session receives the message and triggers an :input event (verifiable via session subscription)
- [ ] Test: extension that calls Host.register_tool(ctx.host, %{name: "x", ...}) → tool appears via Host.get_all_tools(ctx.host) and is in Session's active tools
- [ ] When `mix pi` runs with an extension that calls Host.send_message from on_event/3, no GenServer.cast(nil, ...) ArgumentError appears in telemetry handler_error events
- [ ] In Runner: `ctx.host = state.session_pid` is set wherever ctx is constructed (verifiable via grep)
- [ ] mix test passes

## Dependencies

Blocked by: opi-fin.13
title: Session implements Host callbacks; set ctx.host
